view-01.png.evidence: Distinct aircraft markings, hull and quiet smoke preserve much of the formation.
view-01.png.regressions: Center remains crowded; pale wave pattern and soft small details limit definition.

view-02.png.evidence: Strong directional light and props give the market density and depth; colored routes identify activity.
view-02.png.regressions: Warm shadows hide figures among crowded stalls, and route lines cross nearby props.

view-03.png.evidence: Wing markings remain distinct in isolated positions.
view-03.png.regressions: Soft central silhouettes, disk effects and inline labels muddy the fight.

view-04.png.evidence: Pale brackets frame the bow overlap. Orange impact sparks and cream wings remain distinct on deep blue water.
view-04.png.regressions: Nearby aircraft cross the bracketed area, and the course strip hides parts of aircraft near the top.

view-05.png.evidence: Open aircraft brackets draw the eye to the bow. The shaded superstructure, fine water texture and distinct stern wake give the carrier depth.
view-05.png.regressions: The aircraft silhouette loses contrast at the deck edge and the wake softens into a single pale trail.
